title: AER Hardware Remote Attestation Schema
description: Deterministic schema for proving silicon-backed identity based on IETF RATS (RFC 9334) with zero-knowledge blinded commitment to prevent persistent tracking (AER Axiom 1).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the schema specification (e.g. 1.0.0).

node_id.description: EVM-compatible Ethereum hex address of the node derived from its operational public key.

blinded_silicon_commitment.description: Pedersen commitment Commit(Chip_Secret, r) blinding the physical silicon identifier into a zero-knowledge nullifier.

platform_pcr_digest.description: SHA-256 composite digest of Platform Configuration Registers (PCR 0-7: firmware, secure boot state, and kernel measurements).

ak_public_key.description: DER or PEM encoded public key of the Attestation Key (AK) generated inside the hardware boundary.

quote_signature.description: Hexadecimal cryptographic signature generated by the TPM/TEE AK over the quote_payload and nonce.

quote_payload.description: TPM2B_ATTEST or TEE attestation evidence structure encoded in base64 or hex.

proof_type.description: Proof system used to prove Root CA membership without revealing individual certificate serials.

proof_bytes.description: Compressed serialization of the zero-knowledge or DAA proof.

public_inputs.description: Public signals/inputs associated with the ZK circuit (e.g. root hash of the vendor CA Merkle tree, nonce hash).

silicon_firmware_version.description: Reported firmware/microcode release version from the secure element.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds at the time of attestation generation.

nonce.description: 32-byte cryptographic nonce provided by the challenger or verifier to prevent replay attacks.
